description: Na₂Nb₂(P₂O₇)₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.39 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.98 Å) and three longer (2.00 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-41°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.62 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one P atom.
